passage.label: Heaven constructed strength indeed expander; earth spread out excellent preparer; all things created two mates perhaps remember; flee Allah indeed I from Him clear warner; do not make equal Allah another deity indeed I from Him clear warner; similarly came not those before messenger except said magician madman; suggest them rather transgressing people; leave them Muhammad not blamed; remind indeed reminder benefits believers

arabicExcerpts.text: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ

mainSubject.label: Heaven constructed with strength and expanded, earth spread out by an excellent preparer; all things created in pairs inviting remembrance; flight to Allah urged since the Prophet is a clear warner from Him; prohibition of making any deity equal to Allah reiterated with the same warner-commission; every prior messenger likewise dismissed as magician or madman, not through mutual suggestion but because they are themselves a transgressing people; the Prophet told to leave them since he is not blameworthy, and to remind since reminder benefits believers

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

And remind, for indeed the reminder benefits the believers.

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the Lord-of-heaven-and-earth oath (23) before the Abraham-guests narrative opens (24); P2 ends with Noah's people as defiantly disobedient (46) before the cosmic-signs block begins (47); P3 runs from heaven-construction through the reminder-benefits-believers close (47-55); P4 covers the worship-purpose declaration through the closing woe (56-60).
